pages.text: Stability is the reactor's health, from 0 to 100%.$(br2)It drops with stabilizer offset, laser power, ring stress and low mass. It recovers slowly when you ease off.$(br2)$(good)Above 50%$(): Stable$(br)$(warn)Below 50%$(): Warning$(br)$(danger)Below 20%$(): Pre-meltdown

pages.title: Reactor States
pages.text: Every fault can be fixed or timed out.
